description: UK job ads from Gumtree for a town or city and optional keyword: title, location (area, town), pay text as posted (e.g. £13/hour, up to £650/week), tags such as contract type and recruiter, featured flag, how long ago it was posted, ad ID and URL, about 30 per page, plus the total number of matching ads. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

location.description: Town, city or postcode, e.g. london, manchester, M1 (required)

q.description: Optional keyword, e.g. driver, cleaner, chef

name: jobs_gumtree_jobs
title: Jobs Gumtree Jobs
